notes.title: New content
notes.content:
Version 1.5.1

 Added a new arena: Hockey
 Added two new players
 Minor bug fixing

notes.title: Minor update 1.3.3a
notes.content:
Hello there,
some minor updates, check the list below.

See you soon,
the Shootball Arena team.

Change Log

1.3.3a changes

 now if you lose connection while playing the game no longer freeze


1.3.2a changes

 added music and fx volume controll in the option menu 
 now the ball falls perpendicular on start
 fixed the bug that affected the player while standing on barrier 
 super shot power reduced by 33%
 powerups keep being spawned it the match owner quits


1.3.1a changes

 now the player floats in the air less time while jumping
 supershot timing reduced while jumping
 increased the camera pitch
 the ball now freezes the player only hitting him at high speed
 the player no longer floats in the air while freezing
 increased aiming accuracy
 added new crossahair effect while aiming

notes.title: 8 April: early access is coming.
notes.content:
Hello,
following our plan to release more and more content here we are with a new update.

A gang of bikers is joining the arena: riding their motorbikes they can't carry too much weight of course, but the small SMG and the short barrel shotgun they can choose from are extremely dangerous indeed... I'm pretty sure some players will find a way to make good use of both. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648670/46bb33259033f6e82584ab4abb7dff2050d9915a.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648670/f668677981515233415c3adf46e77d4ccbe84b22.png

Looking at the image above you will find that we also added the nickname over the player's head... at least now you can read who's beating you :). Of course you will be able to switch on/off this feature in the option menu ( about the option menu, it is still in alpha stage and needs more work to be completed, so don't worry if you can see only few options at the moment ).

So, let's recap some features: 

 online match up to 6 players ( will be 10 in the final release )
 3 different arenas
 8 characters 
 6 weapons
 2 passive and 3 active powerups 
 super shot by hitting the ball with the right timing while jumping
 offline training mode to become familiar with controls


Having this new update ready to go we finally reached the point where we have enough content to take the next step and let you have lots of fun playing shootball and help us make the best game we can thanks to your valuable feedback.

So, ta-daaaa! We are pleased to announce that we are entering early access on 8 April :).

More is coming, stay connected.

The Shootball Arena team.

notes.title: Restyling and new features
notes.content:
Hi, 
those who follow us may have noticed that we have replaced the gameplay footage and all the pictures in the landing page with better ones... we hope :). The reason is that we have restyling all the characters from scratch, moving from the old cartoonish to a new semi-realistic style which in our opinion better suit the rest of the game ( at this point you may wonder why on Earth we chose a cartonish style for our characters in the first place, but please... don't ask... really don't :).

[previewyoutube=81fsRFHGKdg;full][/previewyoutube]
In addition we are also working to improve game mechanics more and more, so we added two main features here:

Super shot
Power ups


Super shot
The super shot is.... a super shot. Ok, I guess I should give you some more detail here. Watching the video you can see your crosshair shaking at a certain point while you are jumping: shooting in that very moment your weapon power increases by about three times and hitting the ball  you get the super shot... and a wonderful flaming ball indeed.

Power ups
Power ups give the gameplay more depth being able to be used in many different ways: for example you can throw the magnet to avoid an opponent's goal or lift the ball and get ready for the super shot. Power ups randomly appear in the arena and refresh on goal or every 30 seconds ( if I'm not wrong ).
Here are the ones we made so far, others will be added in the future:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648670/a6198e863c01e58b4fba849e0804958163f44385.png Passive, increases your character skills
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648670/6db96dc74740299519d71c3cddff6361cab5fcbe.png Passive, increases your current weapon stats
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648670/615d94f1bf20434c3bb9b17770df961ffbfd493f.png Active, makes a wall appear on the field
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648670/195d3d7edd84aa087d9a94401016c8cdf2b5ed9d.png Active, throws a grenade freezing all the opponent players in a given range
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648670/e98a883950ab49d273584582ec827ec68dc2d942.png Active, attracts the ball

At the very moment we are working on the third arena and some other characters, in order for you to have enough content to enjoy with and for us to take the next step: early access is coming soon.... yeah :)

That's all for today folks.

Stay tuned and be ready,
the Shootball Arena team.
